author: Jeff Geerling
description:
Heading out to set up my NTP Time demo in less than 24 hours. No time remains!

Be sure to check out my demo at VCF Midwest if you're in Chicago this weekend:
https://geerlingguy.github.io/vcfmw21-map/#045

Some of the resources, tools, and parts I mentioned in this video (some links are affiliate links):

  - Video on TrueTime Restomod: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CivRNW0b1H8
  - Video on Xserve G5 Restoration: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kFnvZ4NWr00
  - BlueSCSI: https://bluescsi.com
  - YesterYear's MacGames: https://www.youtube.com/@YesterYearsMacGames
  - InfiniteMac: https://infinitemac.org
  - SE/30 LED Holder: https://www.printables.com/model/875844-macintosh-se30-hdd-led-bracket/comments
  - Noctua Fan (NF-A6x25 PWM): https://amzn.to/4yucDXM
  - CRT Adjustment Tool: https://www.printables.com/model/276900-tv-set-crt-alignment-tool-tweaker/comments
  - Glarks Rivets (used R3545 in SE/30): https://amzn.to/4gJ5HQB
  - 68KMLA on Tardis and Timelord: https://68kmla.org/bb/
title: I'm completely out of time
